title: The 11-11 Club and other Chicago jobs from 1950
summary: He dates his start at the 11-11 to June 1950 or 51 and lists his stints at the Red Arrow, Tom Tom and Preview.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: They sold a couple of million records. And then from there, I went into the Brass River for three weeks with Schwartz, and that's when the 11-11 come and got me.
Oh, I went in there at 50... What was it? 52?
I know it was June the 6th, because it was on Ted Lewis' birthday. I think it was 50 or 51.
You've been there about seven years.

Yeah, I'm going on eight now, yeah. It was about 50 or 51. I know it was June the 6th. And then I left the 11-11, and I went out to the Red Arrow for three months. Did very good out there. Came back. Then I went out to the TomTom with Danny Alvin for three months. Did very good out there. And then came back to the 11-11. And I left there and went to the Preview for three months, and here I am back again.
